text: When a pilot reports windshear conditions to ATC, the information shall be relayed to subsequent inbound and outbound aircraft until confirmation is received that the conditions no longer exist. Windshear can occur at any level, but it is low-level windshear occurring from the surface to a height of approximately 1,500 feet. Question. At what altitude does windshear occur? Question.
